Failure to produce original documents will lead to disqualification. work done certificate should have all the details CR no, work order issuing date, work completion date and year as asked in bid document, 36)The Applicant shall be registered in KPWD/CPWD Organizations and shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by GOK/GOI, 37)Restrictions on Public Procurement from Bidders of certain countries as per Government order No. FD 455 Exp-12 2020 Bengaluru dated:01-04-2023, 38)The agencies participating in the tender shall be registered in the Construction Labour Board as per the G.O. No. LD 300 LET 2006 Dated:18-1-2007 and Addendum No. LD 95 LET 2013 Bengaluru Dt:1-4-2013. Also the contractors entrusted with the work shall employ the labours only who have registered in the Karnataka Building and Construction Workers Welfare Board failing which the contractor shall be liable for any further action as deemed by the authority.

The Contractor is responsible for the proper maintenance of equipment / material as well as protection of the same against theft, elements of nature, damages etc., while in his custody as well as after erection until the same is taken over by the EXECUTIVE ENGINEER under due acknowledgment in writing, 40)Each Item Of BOQ To be read as with all lead and lifts including loading and unloading charges and as per the direction of Engineer in charge, 41)Uploaded drawings are for TENDER PURPOSE ONLY, 42)It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee into the respective receiving bank accounts of KPP PORTAL on or before the last date and time of bid submission, 43)The tenderer shall also disclose if there are any bankruptcy proceedings against him, 44)The tender processing charges paid by the bidder/ firm/ company are not refundable even if the tenders are cancelled, 45)For payments related to GST, contractor should abide to prevailing FD Order no 417 EXP-12/2024 bengaluru dated 09-08-2024, 46)The Bidder shall quote Rates WITHOUT adding PREVAILING GST for either materials or works Contract (Service)GST payable by the contractor under this work/contract will be paid to the contractor

itemList.description: Geophysical investigation of site for sinking bore well for supplying drinking water to the habitation either through the hand pump, MWS, PWSS by vertical electrical sounding by adopting venner of schlumbergers method including reconnaissance survey of geological formation, geophysical investigation of existing ground water in the vicinty,; indicating the location of site, recommended depth of casing pipe required to seal the top unconsolidated formation including extra depth of 1.0 Mtrs. in consolidated formation for proper seating of casing pipe, depth of drilling equired to cover full depth of aquifer proposed to be tapped, probable yield and other information required inclulding transportation of instrument and accessories to work site, engaging technical personnel and labour required etc., complete.(Common SR:2023-24 Vol-V, RDW&SD, Page No 140: Item Nos 12.4)
